(2) DIORAMA: ShopFloor rooms behind collidable Door + glass (city 281, uptown 206, beachfront 43, millak 20, namcheon 6) — NPC staff stand inside (ShopStaff) and Annex teleports you to an unrelated off-map room. (3) FACADE: solid Core/GroundCore/Mass; RoomDepth/RoomGlass fake rooms on upper floors; namcheon lit storefronts without floor. GLOBAL CRUDENESS (walk-in shops): every shop uses the same kit — one flat floor slab (WoodPlanks / Slate-like / Marble-like / Concrete), one flat back wall and two flat partitions with no finish, one flat ceiling slab with downlights; the same template fixtures in 111 of 134 shops (2 CassetteAC, FireExtinguisher+ExitSign, Baseboard x3, DoorPlanter/DoorShrub, A-frame/X-banner) and a Door_restroom leaf on the back wall that leads nowhere in 74; no water purifiers, trash/tray return, napkin/condiment sets, wall menus with prices, 원산지 boards, TVs (except pubs), wall decor; kitchens are a KitchenPass/PassLedge strip (no burners/pots/fryers); seats are kit chairs. 7 storefronts (바삭치킨, 해변 호프, 광안 치킨 & 맥주, 행복 돼지국밥, 부산어묵 광안점, 비치용품 · 튜브대여, 광안 기념품샵 PORT) have WORKING AutoDoors into an empty unlit void up to the GroundCore.
